name: Terraform Cloud API
tagline: REST API for HCP Terraform workspaces, runs, state, and orgs.
description: JSON:API for HCP Terraform (formerly Terraform Cloud) at app.terraform.io. Manage organizations, workspaces, runs, variables, state versions, and teams via Bearer tokens. Versioned under /api/v2 with Content-Type application/vnd.api+json. Free tier covers up to 500 managed resources; paid plans scale by resource under management.

auth.details: Bearer token (user, team, or organization) via Authorization: Bearer header. Create tokens in UI at app.terraform.io Settings → Tokens, or via Team/Organization Token APIs. Content-Type: application/vnd.api+json required.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Enhanced Free: up to 500 managed resources, 1 concurrent run, unlimited users (legacy Free EOL Mar 31 2026). API access included; not request-quota free.
pricing.paid_plans: Essentials ~$0.10, Standard ~$0.47, Premium ~$0.99 per managed resource/month (pay-as-you-go). Trial credits may apply for new orgs.

rate_limits: Published: ~30 req/s per IP for most endpoints; some endpoints lower (e.g. run polling, auth). 429 Too Many Requests when exceeded. Check official API docs rate-limiting section.
use_cases: list organizations and workspaces for an account
trigger or poll a Terraform run on a workspace
read or upload Terraform state versions
manage workspace variables and variable sets
create team or organization API tokens programmatically
